title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description:
Can YOU guess which egg is hiding the baby dragon? 🐉 Watch to find out! Like and subscribe for a new challenge every day!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #FunForKids #Kidify #BrainTeaser #EggChallenge

scenes.narration: A baby dragon is hiding inside one of these eggs! Which one is it?
Your choices are — the red egg, the blue egg, or the golden egg!
Pick your egg right now — and let's count down! Three… two… one!
The red egg cracks open — and it's just a rubber chicken! Nope!
The blue egg opens up — and out pops a tiny frog! So close!
The GOLDEN egg cracks open — and there's the baby dragon! You found it!
Did you pick the golden egg? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
